newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates steady to lower.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were steady to lower, reflective of the softness in the overnight money market, traders said on Tuesday.
The one, two and three-month rates nudged down in line with the dip in the 91-day Treasury bill rate in Monday's auction to an average of 10.673 from 10.727 percent.
The one-year PHIBOR rate also slipped.
Traders said banks were liquid because they were reluctant to invest in term reverse repos due to the 20 percent tax imposed since January 2.
